_about: Average-speed sections of the Ministry of Internal Affairs of Georgia, from its press releases (sources), for the navigator's section warnings (scripts/geocoder_cameras.py section_rows). Each end is an OSM km post (highway=milestone) of the road the release names, whose number is the release's km and whose nearest village or junction is the one the release names, or the junction itself; 'evidence' says which. The build puts each end on the carriageway of that road which runs the section's way. Only sections whose both ends could be placed this way are here; not_placed lists the rest and why. The releases are from 2018-2021: a section may have moved or changed its limit since, and the road signs always win. This is never the full list.
